comment: VP-4 combat board (D-700): the art names the board looks up (ArtLookup kinds orb, footer, component and icon: ui/art.json), the icons its overhead and chips draw, and the geometry identities of the mana ring. Names of UXML regions and classes are in ui.json (UiNames, UiClasses).

keySets.name: BoardArt
keySets.doc: Names of the art the combat board looks up by kind (ui/art.json lookup: orb.{name}, footer.{name}, uicomp.{name}).

keySets.name: BoardIcons
keySets.doc: Content icon names the combat board draws (icon.{name}: ui/art.json iconAlias applies).

numberSets.name: BoardMath
numberSets.doc: Geometry identities of the combat board (not tuning): the mana ring of the Orb is a circle of up to twelve diamonds, one every 30 degrees (web footerLayout.json mana-0..mana-11 sit at 30-degree steps around the frame).
